The '''Strangled Cliffs''' were a cluster of highly-elevated cliffs on the<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order" /> [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TFAVD">''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[planet]] [[Dathomir]]. The cliffs were home to a wide range of terrain which were home to [[Bane Back Spider|bane back spider]]s, [[Lesser Nydak|nydaks]] as well as their [[Nydak Alpha]] cousins, and the [[chirodactyl]] [[bat]]s. The [[Nightsisters|Nightsister]] [[Dathomiri clan|clan]] of [[Dathomirian]] [[witch]]es and their [[Nightbrothers|Nightbrother]] [[Soldier|warriors]] held several locations on the cliffs including a [[Unidentified Nightbrother arena|Nightbrother arena]] in the [[Swamp of Sacrifice]] and the nearby [[Witches Horn]]. The uppermost section of the cliffs were known as the [[Upper Strangled Cliffs]]. After the [[Second Battle of Dathomir|destruction]] of their previous [[Nightbrother village|village]]<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order" /> in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="SoD Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the [[Second Battle of Dathomir]] to [[19 BBY]].</ref> the Nightbrothers constructed a new [[Unidentified Nightbrother village|village]] in the Upper Strangled Cliffs and several outposts throughout the cliffs.<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order" />
